    # Base script variables and constraints
    ENGINE_get_id_e = Int('ENGINE_get_id_e')
    id = Int('id')

    engines   = Int('engines')

    post_cmds = Int('post_cmds')
    argv      = Int('argv')
    argv_deref_deref = Int('argv_deref_deref')
    o         = Int('o')
    OPT_EOF   = IntVal(-1)
    engine_id = String('engine_id')
    id_str    = String('id_str')

    # Base script constraint
    s.add(ENGINE_get_id_e == id)

    # Constraint set 2 constraints
